Description:
Multi-agent review wedged on finalize. Two root causes + supporting fixes.
DumpSink rendered each worker's multi-MB markdown through glamour on the finalize goroutine; glamour is super-linear (6s@2MB, 49s@4MB, minutes+ beyond), freezing "Finalizing output...". Fix: DumpSink writes plain markdown (workers are raw material; final report stays styled, drill-in still works). mdrender.Render also caps at 256KB -> raw fallback for the remaining glamour callers.
(from the real error trace) The run reached the Claude Code synthesis step, then the user Ctrl+C'd the hang. Because the workers had already finished, summary.Cancelled was false, so writePostReviewManifest ran on the now-cancelled run context and failed: "write to disk failed: resolve git common dir: git rev-parse: context canceled" -> findings silently discarded after a 16-min review. Fix: persist on a detached context (context.WithoutCancel) with a 30s deadline so completed findings survive a cancel during finalize.
Supporting:
TUI keeps a spinner + elapsed timer during finalize so a slow finish is visible, not frozen.
runFinishedMsg lets the authoritative summary downgrade an optimistic stream Succeeded to failed/cancelled so rows and counts agree.
Worker prompt asks for compact output to curb the bloat at the source.
Commits: 2b104c02d (finalize hang), 80dd3d82a (findings persistence on cancel).
